core_message: The MOAB was built as a show of force and was actually dropped only once in combat. Its power is far greater than its real use.
title: MOAB: How Often Has It Been Dropped in War?
description:
The GBU-43 MOAB is known as the most powerful non-nuclear bomb in the US arsenal. This video traces how it was developed, what it was meant to do, and why it has been used in combat only once.

Based on the Wikipedia article "GBU-43/B MOAB" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GBU-43/B_MOAB), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
